name: Polygon Smash
author: Lv1Password
description: This Super Smash Bros-inspired fighting game was created by my friend (Inha Kim) and I. We created this game from scratch by making all player sprites and game logic. All the music and fonts in the game are imported and you can see their creators under "credits" in our game menu. The font used in this game is "Free Pixel Font - Thaleah" from the asset store.
